svg.title: British Columbia / Lands Department / Forest Service
svg.desc: Clean designed reconstruction of the photographed badge. Smooth geometry and outlined type replace all image-derived contours. Relief, hammered grain, ageing, reflections and display stands are omitted. Exact original typeface, die engraving and material tones cannot be authenticated; the few silver/bronze fills are a material interpretation. The SERVICE word is fitted inside the lower ring; the tree trunk is interrupted behind that lettering to represent layered metal relief without merging the outlines. Exact root engraving and the original alphabet remain unresolved.
